rationale: All runs are limited by a port path at ss 100C; with timing-driven placement T_eff ~ 0.2 x target (I/O delay) + d_io, and d_io stays 3.85 ns across util, density, slew/cap, margins, post-GRT timing and stock/orfs RC: +5.5 ns slack means repair never touches it. Only the netlist moved it: DELAY 4 + ABC buffering gave 3.71 (best 6.052); cap213 costs ~0.45. ABC's upsize/dnsize run against the loose 11.7 ns target, likely shrinking port-path gates to minimum size. Keep period_frac 0.45, TD, low util: (1) DELAY 4 with ABC buffering and sizing off (delay-optimal mapping); (2) DELAY 4 + buffering, sizing off, stock RC, util 20 (a near-replay of the best if buffering forces sizing).
